dropbox.local_folder_hint:
Simplest: choose 'Dropbox folder on this PC' if you have the Dropbox app installed.
Your Dropbox folder is usually at  C:\Users\You\Dropbox.
dropbox.token_hint: Generate a token at dropbox.com/developers → App Console → Settings.
dropbox.app_key_hint:
Create an app at dropbox.com/developers → App Console.
Use 'Full Dropbox' or 'App folder' access. Copy the App Key here.
dropbox.guide_step2: Choose Scoped access → Full Dropbox → name it SaveSync → Create
dropbox.guide_step3: Copy the App key from the Settings tab and paste it below
dropbox.token_step1: Go to Dropbox App Console → select your app (or create one)
dropbox.token_step2: Go to the Settings tab → scroll to OAuth 2 section
dropbox.token_step3: Click Generate under 'Generated access token' and paste it below
dropbox.oauth_callback_close: You can close this tab and return to SaveSync.

google_drive.local_folder_recommended: 📁  Google Drive folder on this PC (recommended)
google_drive.local_folder_hint:
Simplest: choose the local folder option if you have Google Drive for Desktop installed.
Your Drive folder is usually at  C:\Users\You\Google Drive.
google_drive.select_folder_hint: Select your Google Drive folder (e.g. C:\Users\You\Google Drive).
google_drive.client_secret_hint:
Create a project at console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Credentials.
Create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Desktop app), download the JSON, and select it here.
google_drive.service_account_hint: Service account key JSON file from Google Cloud Console.
google_drive.guide_step1: Go to Google Cloud Console → Create Project → name it SaveSync
google_drive.guide_step2: Enable the Google Drive API (APIs & Services → Library → search 'Drive')
google_drive.guide_step3: Go to Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth Client ID → type: Desktop app
google_drive.guide_step4: Click Download JSON and select the downloaded file below
google_drive.sa_step1: Go to Google Cloud Console → Service Accounts → Create Service Account
google_drive.sa_step2: Name it SaveSync → grant role Editor (or Owner) → Done
google_drive.sa_step3: Click the new account → Keys tab → Add Key → JSON → download and select below
google_drive.no_folder_path: No Google Drive folder path configured

onedrive.local_folder_hint:
Simplest: choose 'OneDrive folder on this PC' if you have the OneDrive app installed.
Your OneDrive folder is usually at  C:\Users\You\OneDrive.
onedrive.azure_app_hint:
Register a free app at portal.azure.com → App registrations → New registration.
Set platform to 'Mobile and desktop applications' and redirect URI to 'https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/nativeclient'.
Copy the Application (client) ID here.
onedrive.graph_token_hint: Generate a token via Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer).
onedrive.signin_advanced: 🔧  Sign in with custom Azure app
onedrive.guide_step2: Name it SaveSync, select Personal Microsoft accounts only
onedrive.guide_step3:
Under Authentication → Add platform → Mobile and desktop → add redirect URI:
https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/nativeclient
onedrive.guide_step4: Copy the Application (client) ID from the Overview page and paste it below
onedrive.token_step1: Go to Graph Explorer and sign in with your Microsoft account
onedrive.token_step2: Click your profile icon (top-right) → Consent to permissions → enable Files.ReadWrite
onedrive.token_step3: Copy the Access Token from the top of the page and paste it below

rclone.base_folder_hint: Optional extra sub-folder on the remote. Saves already go under SaveSync/ — leave empty unless you want an additional prefix.

webdav.username_hint: Your account username or email address.
